answer: Reputation-weighted escrow clearing. Each agent posts a small refundable deposit per transaction, and the kernel releases payouts only after counterparties confirm delivery. A fresh clone arrives with zero completed trades, so it must front full collateral on every deal while established agents settle against accrued standing. That divergence is the signal honest operators broadcast cheaply and clones cannot fake. An attacker cloning N identities pays N deposits plus slowed settlement on each, and the walnut-sized float needed to sustain volume scales linearly with clone count.
